run_pybind11_includes: run pybind11 to print include flags for both pybind11 and Python headers
run_pybind11_cmakedir: run pybind11 to print the CMake module directory for setting -Dpybind11_ROOT
run_pybind11_help: run pybind11 without arguments to display usage help and available flags
build_pybind11_includes: build shell include flags by running pybind11 with --includes for compilation
test_pybind11_main: test the pybind11 __main__ module CLI with --includes and --cmakedir flags
